mintAuthority.summary: VNDC has independently native issuance on Ethereum, Polygon, and BSC through Jade Labs / issuer-controlled deployments. The legacy Ethereum VNDCToken exposes owner-only issue(uint) and burn(uint) paths plus a custom deprecate(address) replacement path; Polygon and BSC TokenVNDC expose owner/admin-controlled whitelist-and-collateral mintWhitelist()/withdrawWhitelist() paths. No authored deployment is a bridge representation, and bridge machinery is assessed separately under Bridge Risk. The current-product link between the legacy Ethereum deployment and the VNDC 2.0 program remains an evidence gap, but its local issuance capability is verified.

review.evidence: Native issuance is reviewed on all three authored deployments. At Ethereum block 25770655 (2026-08-16T22:35:47Z), the verified VNDCToken owner 0x004D050267B7cBdD223A591824c34F69A8a7A7b7 is an EOA, paused() is false, and owner-only issue(uint), burn(uint), and deprecate(address) are present; issue has no fixed economic cap. At Polygon block 92143560 (2026-08-16T22:46:18Z), owner() on 0xd0076d7e57aac42ec3f9d6e7c604d04a5b7030fa returned EOA 0x557D55E71204CE7DfDc5C839446Dd34F1b299354, paused() was false, and the verified TokenVNDC source exposes local whitelist-and-collateral mintWhitelist()/withdrawWhitelist() paths. At BSC block 116354795 (2026-08-16T22:46:24Z), owner() on 0xa276dc434a366c62ef010585b3885d0c85154389 returned the same EOA and paused() was false; the byte-identical TokenVNDC source has the same local issuance design. Polygon and BSC totalSupply() reads were 2,560,000,000 and 12,797,267,932 respectively (decimals 0), supporting independent local liabilities rather than bridge-conservation accounting. The Ethereum deployment is legacy and its current product-support link to VNDC 2.0 is not fully proven, so that limitation remains an evidence gap. Mint Authority now names one control per native deployment; no bridge-only capability is included, and Bridge Risk contains no bridge controls. Economic-posture fields remain concentrated-admin, unbounded, unknown reconciliation, and no supervision.
